entities.summary: Gwangsan Noh clan was one of the Korean clans. Their Bon-gwan was in Gwangju. According to the research in 2015, the number of Gwangsan Noh clan was 102329. Their founder was Noh Hae. His father, Noh Su, fled from China with his children to avoid An Lushan Rebellion happened in 755. Noh Hae, eldest son of Noh Su(Hanja: 盧穂), was appointed as Prince of Gwangsan and began Gwangsan Noh clan.
